text:
maria: quick async midday check — API gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits. please drop 1-2 lines: what you did, blockers, and today.

sam: did — canaryed routing v5 to 10% (eu-west). saw a small spike in 429s (~1%) for long-lived streams. watching. :eyes:

ben: did — rolled auth key rotation patch to staging. blocker: a handful of legacy clients still send old kid and get 401s. patch to client lib in progress.

chandra: did — finished rate-lint validator updates, PR open: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/812. needs one more review for the new burst rule.

alyssa: did — fixed prefix match edgecase (route /v1/data vs /v1/datapoint). hotfix deployed to staging, metrics look stable.

kevin: did — looked at smoke-test failures from yesterday, reproduced flaky assertion around rate headers. will push small test change today.

maria: blocker question — can we lower default burst for internal routes? proposing to reduce from 100 -> 20 for the internal tier to avoid short-term token storms. sample snippet below for ops review: 

```yaml
routes:
  - id: /api/v1/generate
    rate_limit:
      requests_per_minute: 1200
      burst: 20
```

sam: +1 to reducing burst for internal routes, but let's exclude inference stream endpoints for now (they need higher headroom). we should monitor 5m p95 after change.

ben: noted. rotation schedule for keys is set for 13:00 PST today — I'll post a short incident note if we see >2% 401s.

chandra: small blocker — CI flakes on staging are holding up the PR merge. re-running jobs now. devops-bot: re-run queued.

devops-bot: [CI] pipeline for PR #812 retriggered by chandra — run id 5723. currently queued on runners.

alyssa: small ask for reviewers: when you review the rate-lint PR, please also check that the rollout policy includes a canary with automatic rollback on error-rate >0.5%.

kevin: will add header assertion to the smoke tests: `assert 'x-rate-limit-remaining' in resp.headers` and a basic negative test for 429 semantics. targeting EOD.

maria: thanks — action items: ben posts rotation ETA in #incidents at 12:45, chandra monitors CI and merges if green, kevin updates smoke tests, chandra/kevin to watch p95 after burst change. i'll draft the changelog entry + ops checklist.

sam: FYI, i'll keep the canary at 10% for another 2 hours and then bump to 30 if 429s remain <=1%.

ben: if anyone hits auth regressions after rotation, add `x-client-kid` header to the incident thread so we can trace.

maria: cool — thanks all. ping here if you need pairing. :thumbsup:
